Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.theme

Class MapTheme

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.theme.MapTheme
public final class MapTheme extends Object
Immutable value object that encapsulates the complete visual style used when rendering a map and its decorations (graticule, country borders, city markers, labels, ocean fill, and projection outline).

Usage

Obtain an instance either from one of the built-in presets (light(), dark(), blue()) or by constructing a custom theme with the nested MapTheme.Builder:


 MapTheme custom = new MapTheme.Builder()
         .backgroundColor(Color.WHITE)
         .oceanColor(new Color(0xADD8E6))
         .landColor(new Color(0x90EE90))
         .build();

To tweak an existing theme without rebuilding it from scratch use toBuilder(), which copies every field into a new MapTheme.Builder ready for modification.

Thread safety

MapTheme instances are effectively immutable once constructed and may be shared freely across threads and rendering layers.

Projection integration

Each IMapProjection holds a reference to its active MapTheme. The projection consults the theme when drawing the map outline, graticule lines, and the ocean fill. Renderers such as CountryRenderer and CityPointRenderer obtain the theme via the projection so that all layers remain visually consistent.

    • toBuilder

      public MapTheme.Builder toBuilder()
      Creates a new MapTheme.Builder pre-populated with every field from this theme. Useful for creating a variation without specifying every value: 
      
 MapTheme brighter = existingTheme.toBuilder()
         .landColor(Color.GREEN)
         .build();
      Returns:
      a mutable MapTheme.Builder that reproduces this theme

    • light

      public static MapTheme light()
      Returns a light-background theme suitable for daytime use or printing.
      • Background: near-white (#F0F0F0)
      • Ocean: light blue (#CDE8FF)
      • Land: pale green (#E3F2D9)
      • Cities: red

      a new light MapTheme instance
